rows.author: E026
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR DEBT-RELIEF MEASURES TO REHABILITATE FINANCIALLY DISTRESSED ENTERPRISES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Corporate Recovery Act.\" The bill offers distraught enterprises debt-relief measures that will secure their survival and, at the same time, protect the rights of creditors with duly registered liens against the assets of these enterprises.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 2004-08-10

rows.author: D086
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING DECEMBER 10 OF EVERY YEAR AS 'HUMAN RIGHTS DAY'
rows.abstract: \"Human Rights Day Act.\" To instill awareness and foster promotion and respect for basic rights and individual freedom, the bill seeks to declare December 10 of every year as a special working holiday.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-08-10

rows.author: C022
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE RETIREMENT BENEFITS OF JUSTICES AND ALL JUDGES IN THE JUDICIARY, FURTHER AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION ONE OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED NINE HUNDRED AND TEN, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill entitles a justice or a judge, who has rendered 15 years of service in the judiciary and who retired at the compulsory age of 70 years, to a basic monthly pension for life starting at the end of the 5-year guarantee period.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-10

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 26, CHAPTER 4, BOOK VI OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NUMBERED 292, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"ADMINISTRATIVE CODE OF 1987\"
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to amend Section 26, Chapter 4, Book VI of E.O 292 thereby repealing the automatic appropriations provision for debt service.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-08-10

rows.author: E026
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING A PROGRAM FOR THE CONTINUING EDUCATION FOR COLLEGE TEACHERS, AMENDING FOR SUCH PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7784, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"AN ACT TO STRENGTHENING TEACHER EDUCATION IN THE PHILIPPINES BY ESTABLISHING CENTERS OF EXCELLENCE, CREATING A TEACHER EDUCATION COUNCIL FOR THE PURPOSE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill requires all primary, secondary and college teachers to undergo training in professional education, general education and teaching methods at least once every five years.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-08-10

rows.status: Substituted by HB03354

rows.author: D064
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE MANDATORY LABELING AND SEGREGATION OF CONSUMER PRODUCTS AND FOOD CONTAINING GENETICALLY ENGINEERED INGREDIENTS AND FOOD PRODUCED BY MEANS OF GNETIC ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGIES, AMENDING FOR THAT PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SEVEN THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED NINETY FOUR, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CONSUMERS' ACT OF THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Genetically Engineered Food Mandatory Labeling and Segregation Act
rows.abstract: \"Genetically Engineered Food Mandatory Labeling and Segregation Act.\" The bill requires the mandatory labeling and segregation of consumer products and food containing genetically modified organisms or genetically engineered ingredients and food produced by means of genetic engineering technologies.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2004-08-10

rows.author: A035
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 59, CHAPTER 7, SUBTITLE A, BOOK V OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 292, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'ADMINISTRATIVE CODE OF 1987'
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to clarify that the exemption to the rule on nepotism refers only to persons being appointed as teachers, physicians or those in confidential positions.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2005-05-04

rows.author: A035
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING CIRCUIT CRIMINAL COURTS TO TRY AND DECIDE CASES OF HEINOUS CRIMES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: To unclog the court dockets, the bill provides for the creation of a circuit criminal court in each of the judicial district of the Regional Trial Courts (RTCs). The circuit criminal court shall have concurrent jurisdiction with the RTC to try and decide on heinous crime cases.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-10

rows.status: Substituted by HB05402

rows.author: E023
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE MONTHLY HONORARIA AND ALLOWANCES OF THE PUNONG BARANGAY, SANGGUNIANG BARANGAY MEMBERS, BARANGAY TREASURER, BARANGAY SECRETARY AND SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN CHAIRMAN AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE SECTION 393 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160 AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to increase the monthly honoraria and allowances to P5,000 for the punong barangay and to P3,000 for the sangguniang barangay members, treasurer, secretary and the sangguniang kabataan chairman. It also grants a Christmas bonus of P3,000 each to the above officials.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-10

rows.author: E023
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING TWO THOUSAND PESOS MONTHLY ALLOWANCE TO ALL BARANGAY TANODS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to grant a P2,000 monthly allowance to barangay tanods but not to exceed 20 barangay tanods in every barangay.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-10

rows.author: D013
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING CERTAIN TOURISM-ORIENTED ESTABLISHMENTS AND TOURIST WORKERS TO SECURE ACCREDITATION FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF TOURISM AS A PREREQUISITE TO THE ISSUANCE OF LICENSE OR PERMIT TO OPERATE BY LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS
rows.abstract: The bill requires tourism-oriented establishments and tourism workers to be accredited by the Department of Tourism prior to the issuance of a license, permit to operate or conduct a tourism-related business by the local government unit.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TOURISM since 2004-08-10

rows.author: D029
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING CYBERCRIME, PROVIDING FOR PREVENTION, SUPPRESSION AND IMPOSITION OF PENALTIES THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks to impose penalties for the following cybercrimes: a) illegal access to the whole or any part of a computer system or network; b) illegal interception; c) data interference; d) system interference; e) misuse of devices; f) computer forgery; g) computer fraud; and h) unsolicited commercial communication.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INFORMATION COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY since 2005-01-12

rows.author: D029
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE REORGANIZATION OF THE NATIONAL POLICE COMMISSION AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"National Police Commission Act of 2004.\" Some of the salient features of the bill include: a) it places the National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) under the Office of the President; b) it provides for the creation of NAPOLCOM District Offices corresponding to the congressional districts; c) it places the PNP Internal Affairs Service under the NAPOLCOM's Internal Affairs Bureau; and d) it authorizes the Mayor and the Governor, as NAPOLCOM deputies, to command the Chief of Police and the PNP Provincial Director, respectively, to ensure the peace and order in their locality.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2004-08-10

rows.author: D029
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A CHARTER OF THE PHILIPPINE PUBLIC SAFETY COLLEGE TO GOVERN ITS ORGANIZATION, ADMINISTRATION AND OPERATION, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Philippine Public Safety College Charter of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Public Safety College Charter of 2004.\" The bill provides for the composition, powers and functions of the Board of Trustees and the operations officers of the College.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2005-04-20

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2005-04-20

rows.author: D029
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROMOTING THE WELFARE OF THE PHILIPPINE COAST GUARD BY INCREASING, INTEGRATING AND RATIONALIZING THE BASE PAY AND OTHER BENEFITS OF ITS OFFICERS AND ENLISTED PERSONNEL, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Magna Carta of the Philippine Coast Guard
rows.abstract: \"Magna Carta of the Philippine Coast Guard.\" The bill provides the personnel of the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) the following: a) rights, duties and responsibilities; b) hours of work, remuneration, welfare, health care and injuries benefits; and c) separation, retirement and death benefits.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-08-10

rows.author: D029
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO INSTITUTIONALIZE SKILLS DEVELOPMENT PLANNING AT THE LOCAL LEVEL, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Institutionalization of Local Skills Development Planning Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Institutionalization of Local Skills Development Planning Act of 2004.\" The bill mandates the local government units to prepare a skills development plan to address the skill development activities in their respective localities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-10

rows.author: D029
rows.title_full: AN ACT REORGANIZING THE NATIONAL FOOD AUTHORITY INTO THE NATIONAL FOOD CORPORATION REDEFINING ITS POWERS, AND CREATING THE FOOD DEVELOPMENT AND REGULATORY ADMINISTRATION, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: National Food Authority Reorganization Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"National Food Authority Reorganization Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks to reorganize the National Food Authority (NFA) into: a) the National Food Corporation, attached to the Office of the President, responsible for buffer stocking for food security purposes, and b) the Food Development and Regulatory Administration, attached the Department of Agriculture, to discharge the regulatory functions of the NFA.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-09-26

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-09-26
Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-09-26

rows.author: C005
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING AN ACROSS THE BOARD SALARY GRADE INCREASE OF PUBLIC LEARNING FACILITATORS, INCLUDING NON-TEACHING POSITIONS IN THE NATIONAL, REGIONAL, DIVISION, SCHOOLS DISTRICT, AND SCHOOL LEVEL, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to upgrade by two salary grades the present salary grade levels of all public learning facilitators, including non-teaching positions, in the national, regional, district and school levels.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-08-10

rows.author: C005
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING LOCAL ELECTIVE EXECUTIVE OFFICIALS FROM MAKING APPOINTMENTS AND INCURRING OBLIGATIONS ON BEHALF OF THEIR RESPECTIVE LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS NINETY (90) DAYS BEFORE THE NEXT REGULAR ELECTIONS UNTIL THE END OF THEIR TERM
rows.title_short: Anti-Midnight Appointments and Transactions Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Anti-Midnight Appointments and Transactions Act of 2004.\" The measure prohibits the rampant practice of issuing appointment papers and/or incurring loans and other obligations by outgoing elective officials in anticipation of the expiration of their term of office.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-10
